newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW mulls own complaint against EU.
newsitem.headline: VW mulls own complaint against EU.

text.p: Auto maker Volkswagen AG is contemplating filing its own complaint against the European Commission in the row over subsidies VW received from the state of Saxony, chief legal officer Jens Neumann said on Wednesday.
The decision must be reached by September 16, and depends on progress in talks between Bonn and Brussels, Neumann told a news conference.
Saxony filed a complaint in the case last Friday with the European Court of Justice in Luxembourg.
Both Bonn and Brussels have indicated they are preparing complaints of their own, though they say they are placing greater importance on discussions for the moment.
The disagreement is over 780 million marks in subsidies for VW to build two plants in the east German state. The EU approved only 540 million marks in subsidies.
